content_sections.heading: NVS Counselor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Master's Degree(M.A/M.Sc.) in Psychology from a recognized university or institution. One year Diploma in guidance & counselling from a recognized university or institution. At least one year experience in Guidance & counseling/Counseling in any recognized school / educational institutes.

content_sections.heading: NVS Counselor Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 28 years Maximum Age: 50 years Age is to be calculated as on 1st June 2026. Age relaxation rules are not specified in the provided data.

content_sections.heading: NVS Counselor Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Consolidated remuneration of Rs.44,900/- per month.

content_sections.heading: NVS Counselor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on marks awarded for essential and desirable qualification (out of 70) Personal Talk (30 Marks)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NVS Counselor Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NVS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NVS Counselor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NVS Counselor recruitment is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Psychology and a One-year Diploma in Guidance & Counselling from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NVS Counselor position?
faq.answer: The age limit is above 28 years and below 50 years as of 1st June 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 44,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Counselor post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q7. Are SC/ST/PH candidates exempted from the application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST/PH candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NVS Counselor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on academic marks and a Personal Talk.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based engagement.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the Important Links section of this article.
